model_execution_target.rule: Every task requests this target and reports VERIFIED|PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED|UNVERIFIED|MISMATCH. Model-sensitive fresh promotion evidence is inadmissible unless the predeclared execution manifest and runtime receipt meet the binding rule.

deep_research.input_rule: Only MM06-safe and MF06-integrated research questions plus unresolved previously accepted research; never raw unverified worker questions.

transport.retry_orphan_rule: next cohort ID derives from generation sequence plus parent-state SHA prefix; retries adopt only exact same-parent artifacts, otherwise stale orphans are never overwritten/adopted

short_full_test.goal: Prove worker GitHub read/auth/write -> MM06 schema/auth/reread verification -> MF06 integration -> BIL00 decision/state advance using existing task sessions, no benchmark/protected evidence.
short_full_test.worker_payload_rule: minimal deterministic transport/report test; no broad public-source research required

runtime_update_rule: No runtime-state change without independently validated RUNTIME_UPDATE_RECEIPT containing artifact hashes, validator results, lineage/accounting identity, before/after diagnostics, required fresh prospective evidence, and preservation/regression checks.
